items.title: Meta contemplates net-zero timeline reset as emissions spike
items.summary: Like its peers in the great data center buildout, Meta’s greenhouse gas emissions increased by double digits in 2025.

items.title: How Agilent is educating its procurement team about climate goals
items.summary: Agilent Technologies has trained close to 250 employees, most from its procurement team, to encourage decarbonization commitments across its supply chain.

items.title: Government launches £28m farming innovation competition
items.summary: # Government launches £28m farming innovation competition The Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs (Defra) has announced £43m in funding to help farmers reduce costs and protect food production, including a £28m innovation competition for projects improving soil and water quality.

items.title: COP31 Covered podcast: İmece, electrification and a stripped-back deal
items.summary: # COP31 Covered podcast: İmece, electrification and a stripped-back deal The tenth episode of edie’s daily COP31 Covered podcast is streaming now, featuring an exclusive interview with We Mean Business Coalition’s Andrew Prag on the business push for a global electrification target.

items.title: One year after COP30, momentum builds for global near-zero methane marketplace
items.summary: # One year after COP30, momentum builds for global near-zero methane marketplace A global near-zero methane marketplace could help accelerate emissions cuts from fossil fuel producers, but only if major importing and exporting countries turn political support into concrete action, argues Environmental Investigation Agency (EIA) campaign lead Kim O'Dowd.

items.title: ‘Supply comes first’: EU methane regulation two-year delay confirmed
items.summary: # ‘Supply comes first’: EU methane regulation two-year delay confirmed The European Commission has confirmed it will postpone methane reporting and verification requirements for oil, gas and coal importers by two years.

items.title: New electrification package launched at COP31 to drive global clean energy investment
items.summary: # New electrification package launched at COP31 to drive global clean energy investment A new global electrification package has been launched at COP31, setting out billions in clean energy investment plans and commitments to expand electricity access, strengthen power grids and accelerate the shift to electric transport, buildings and industry.

items.title: IEA: Energy security concerns strengthen case for renewables and electrification
items.summary: # IEA: Energy security concerns strengthen case for renewables and electrification Although the International Energy Agency (IEA) has found that disruption in the Middle East continues to catalyse renewable and electrification investment, the world remains on track for well above 2C of warming by 2100.

items.title: UK-EU summit: What another ‘reset’ could mean for carbon, energy and the environment
items.summary: # UK-EU summit: What another ‘reset’ could mean for carbon, energy and the environment UK and EU leaders will convene in Brussels on Friday (20 November) for the second UK-EU Summit since Brexit.
